title: Follow-up: sealed obligation scopes and aggregate closure
description: Receiving follow-up for the reduced PR #475 scope; owned by the aggregate scope/closure work corresponding to eshyra-o9bd.19.1.13. Restore regression coverage for source-derived sealed scope membership, exact family and record ownership, not-applicable contradictions, unexpected claims, UNCLAIMED obligations, and closure evaluation using the same per-clause context. These tests were intentionally removed from packages/core/test/clauseIrObligations.test.ts because PR #475 now provides only per-clause completeness and an ObligationSource lookup boundary.
acceptance_criteria: Construct an opaque census-derived scope; reject raw/subset/cross-record/not-applicable membership; report unexpected and UNCLAIMED claims; preserve the evaluator context and source-origin parity during aggregate closure; restore adversarial scope/closure regression tests.
